description: POST /api/v1/auth/register/phone-code/request (or any mail/SMS send) with no RESEND_API_KEY / SMTP_HOST / SMS_API_KEY set: the flow still succeeds (token/code stored, resend possible) but the delivery is an honest logged error, never a claimed success. The admin broadcast path records the channel as failed/not-configured, not sent. ADR-158.

expected.note: response is the same as with delivery configured; the difference is server-side: an error is logged and (for broadcasts) recorded, and no 'delivered' is claimed
